title: Switzerland pattern matches German towns
detail: A user whose places include "Switzerland" gets unanchored fragments such as biel, baden, freiburg, arbon and uster. A posting located "Bielefeld, Germany", "Baden-Württemberg, Germany" or "Freiburg im Breisgau" passes the location filter and reaches the digest and the AI scoring.
impact: Jobs outside the search spend AI money and clutter the digest.
